overall_goal: Strain the hibiscus drink into a bowl using a slotted spoon

goals.description: Move the saucepan to the counter and prepare the workspace
goals.rationale: The person transfers the saucepan from the hob to the counter and sets up a rag to place it on.

goals.description: Retrieve slotted spoons from the drawer and counter
goals.rationale: The person searches for and gathers slotted spoons to use for straining.

goals.description: Wash and rinse the slotted spoons at the sink
goals.rationale: The person washes the retrieved slotted spoons with soap and water to ensure they are clean before use.

goals.description: Retrieve a glass bowl and set it on the counter
goals.rationale: The person gets a glass Pyrex bowl from the draining rack to hold the strained liquid.

goals.description: Strain the hibiscus drink into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person pours the hibiscus drink through the slotted spoon into the bowl to separate the liquid from the leaves and ginger.
